name: Ice Fiend
description: Ice fiends are mischievous creatures from the Abyssal Plane that often serve as front line soldiers for higher entities. They are renowned for the chilling aura and impending feeling of doom they cause moments before their arrival, as well as their giant claw appendage.

actions.name: Ice Spear
actions.description: The ice fiend thrusts a spear of ice at a creature, dealing physical and cold damage.

actions.name: Touch of Ice
actions.description: The ice fiend touches a creature, covering them with a coat of ice that deals cold damage on the start of each of their turns. If the target reaches 0 health while this spell is active, they become frozen in Permafrost instead of rolling a lifeline check. This spell requires the ice fiend's concentration.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: The ice fiend clamps down it's pincer on a medium or smaller target, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Swift Channel
actions.description: The ice fiend channels a spell that normally requires an action.

actions.name: Guillotine
actions.description: The ice devil open it's claw, preparing to make a pincer attack with a 1d4 bonus. The target must make a resilience check against the total damage dealt after mitigation or gain 1 tier of the wounded condition.

traits.name: Aura of Cold
traits.description: The ice fiend gives off a dreadfully cold aura that causes all creatures within 10 units to have a +10 bonus to their fire mitigation and take 3d4 cold damage at the start of their turn.
